Entry Point 01

Rail Safety Regulation & Investigation

Compliance Automation

Railways Act 1993/2005 safety regulation compliance including Railway Safety Regulations 1999, Common Safety Method requirements, and safety certification/validation under the Railway Safety Regulations.

Risk Detection & Early Warning

Detection of rail safety risks via incident trend analysis, safety management system deficiency indicators, and near-miss reporting pattern monitoring.

Natural Language Policy Analysis

NLP analysis of safety management systems, risk assessments, and investigation reports against ORR safety regulatory guidance and EU TSI standards.

Predictive Analytics

Rail safety risk scoring from incident history, safety management maturity, and infrastructure condition data for proactive regulatory intervention.

Evidence Synthesis

Incident investigation reports, safety management data, and inspection findings into safety compliance assessment dossiers.

Document Intelligence

Extraction from safety management systems, incident reports, and Common Safety Method risk assessments for regulatory evaluation.

Stakeholder Reporting

Rail safety dashboards showing incident trends, safety management compliance rates, and regulatory intervention outcomes.

Real-time Monitoring

Incident notification processing, safety management system change monitoring, and Common Safety Method compliance verification.
